title: LISA, Anitta & Rema Score Big With ‘Goals,’ Their Cross-Continental FIFA World Cup Single
summary: The multilingual track is part of the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Album.
contentText:
It’s a hat trick for music and football fans alike: K-pop sensation LISA , Brazilian superstar Anitta , and Afrobeats phenom Rema have united for a global collaboration called “Goals,” the newest single off the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Album , released Thursday (May 21).

“Goals” pulls from three continents worth of culture and creativity, blending energetic yet moody beats with Afro-tinged percussion galore. Produced by Grammy-winner Cirkut alongside Bava and PinkSlip, the single features a percussion-soaked fusion of Latin pop, K-pop and Afrobeats. The multilingual three-minute song exudes confidence, with each artist bringing their dynamic flair to craft a track that sounds electrifying.

“Being a part of the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Album this year has been so exciting,” said LISA in a statement. “Music always unites people across the world, so it has been an honor to work with Anitta and Rema.”

Anitta added, “My connection to the World Cup is deeply emotional. I’m Brazilian, after all, of course I have wonderful memories tied to the tournament. It’s incredibly special to now contribute to its history, collaborating with LISA and Rema on ‘Goals’! I’m very grateful for this opportunity.”

“Three continents, one track … bringing all our sounds together like this is a big moment for music on the world stage,” Rema chimed in.

Released via SALXCO UAM and Def Jam Recordings, “Goals” arrives alongside its official music video — a high-energy visual touchdown that packs as much cultural punch as the song itself. The track will be performed live for the first time during the World Cup’s Los Angeles opening ceremony on June 12.

“Goals” comes after the releases of “Por Ella” by Los Ángeles Azules and Belinda, “Echo” by Daddy Yankee and Shenseea, and “Illuminate” by Jessie Reyez and Elyanna, each offering a unique cultural lens to the Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Album.
